text: Aventro Swift Sedan is an elegant and performance-driven sedan designed for Indian roads. With a blend of advanced safety, modern features, and fuel-efficient technology, the Swift promises comfort, technology, and style. Available in Petrol, Diesel, Electric, and Hybrid variants.

- Body Type: Sedan
- Seating Capacity: 5
- Transmission: Manual / Automatic (depending on variant)
- Infotainment System: Up to 11-inch touchscreen
- ADAS: Level 1 and Level 2 (on higher trims)
- Audio: Up to Harman sound system
- Upholstery: Premium leather seats (on ZX)

- Variant: Petrol | Engine Type: 1.5L SmartTech Engine | Transmission: 5MT / 6AT | Max Power: 113 ps | Fuel Type / Battery: Petrol
- Variant: Diesel | Engine Type: 1.5L TurboCRDi Diesel | Transmission: 6MT | Max Power: 108 ps | Fuel Type / Battery: Diesel
- Variant: Electric | Engine Type: 50 kWh Li-ion battery, FWD | Transmission: Automatic | Max Power: 136 ps | Fuel Type / Battery: Electric
- Variant: Hybrid | Engine Type: 1.5L Hybrid Petrol-Electric | Transmission: CVT | Max Power: 105 ps | Fuel Type / Battery: Hybrid
